environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with DB_USER='app_readwrite' which has been granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the public schema. No WAF or query filtering layer. GraphQL introspection enabled. Network: direct connectivity between app and RDS on port 5432 within the same VPC.

config.db_privileges: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_readwrite
config.network: VPC internal, no WAF, no proxy
